answer.reason: Preexisting coverage gap: both source versions support parsing ordinary text with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE, but the fixed harness always constructs XMLDocument with the preservation default. XML input cannot change that mode. The g0001 cleanup change does not provide another route.
answer.finite_witness: Supply the bytes x y. A supported setup would construct XMLDocument(true, COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE) before Parse; the old harness instead constructs XMLDocument with no arguments.

scope_contract.reason: Whitespace mode is a constructor setting on the XMLDocument used by the target's primary Parse operation, so it belongs to that operation's state contract.

feasible_trigger.reason: Repeated whitespace in ordinary XML text is a finite valid input. Selecting the supported constructor mode causes XMLText::ParseDeep to request whitespace collapsing; the harness fixes the constructor to its preservation default.

observable_consequence.reason: The target cannot exercise the supported whitespace-collapsing parse mode. The mode enables the collapse flag, and StrPair applies it when text is read; the target neither selects that mode nor reads parsed text through another call.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry has one document construction and one Parse call, with no input-controlled mode selection or subsequent route to the collapsing behavior. The supplied g0001 destructor change concerns node cleanup and does not set whitespace mode.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—Parse ordinary text with repeated whitespace under COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE—is supported before and after, and the same old harness blocks it on both sides. This gap is preexisting.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Parse ordinary XML text with COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE selected, enabling whitespace collapse when the text is read.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Construct XMLDocument(true, COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE), then parse x y.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: Construct XMLDocument with no arguments, selecting PRESERVE_WHITESPACE, then call Parse on the input string.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: The target cannot select or exercise the COLLAPSE_WHITESPACE parsing mode.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete entry: input supplies XML bytes only; no call changes the document mode or creates another document.
